items.html: And her VAK are clothed in the VAK of Beria, and they are called the six steps of the Throne. And this Throne is called "the Throne of mercy" (Kursiya de-Rachamei). And her Malchut is clothed in the Malchut of Beria, and she is called "the Throne of judgment" (Kisse Din) — "the blue of Sandalfon" (Tekhelet Sandalfon). However, this is the secret of "the upper Ima nests in the Throne."
